# 论文方法适配与证据审计

把论文中的方法、实验条件、证据强度和用户的实际需求联系起来。交付可核查的阅读判断；机械核查通过不等于科学结论正确。

## 输入与范围

需要论文 PDF，以及用户拟解决的问题、自己的数据/平台条件。补充材料、图表原件和具体关注点按任务提供。目标缺失且会影响判断时先澄清；能完成的证据阅读可先进行。

只根据实际取得的材料作判断。执行论文分析、部署、训练、发消息或公开投稿不属于本 Skill 的阅读任务。

## 阅读和核查

1. **确认材料。** 列出已提供与未提供的正文、补充材料和版本。运行 `python3 <skill>/scripts/build_index.py paper.pdf --out index`。页码指 PDF 第几页，从1开始。已知为节选时加 `--scope excerpt`，已知完整页数时可加 `--expected-pages N`。索引只证明现有页，不能自行证明论文完整。
2. **围绕用户需求阅读。** 先从实际问题列关注项，再检查方法输入输出、数据划分、指标含义、比较对象、关键参数、负结果和作者的限制。阅读图注和相邻上下文；同一个数在不同实验中不能混用。需要时用可用 PDF 图像查看工具核对图表。不要把截图中估读的值写成精确测量。
3. **写证据记录。** 按 `references/claims-schema.md` 写 `claims.json`，同时覆盖用户所需的主要解释和适配判断。FACT 用原文直陈；INFERRED 写推理链，数值推断另列可复算式；UNKNOWN 表示在声明的材料和检索范围内尚未确定。引文从实际索引复制，可被多条结论共用，但每条须独立解释其成立条件。
4. **核查与修正。** 运行 `python3 <skill>/scripts/verify_claims.py --claims claims.json --index index --out verification.json`。失败时回到原文纠正引文、页号、分类或算式，保留重试。脚本仅检查定位、字面值、引用关系和算术；必须另审阅语义支持、适用对象、时间/空间范围、统计指标和因果措辞。数值出现在附近不代表支持该结论。
5. **形成迁移判断。** 逐项给出“可直接用 / 需改造 / 不可用 / 信息不足”，引用证据ID并解释用户条件与论文条件的关系。材料不足不能直接推成“不适用”，实验未验证也不能写“保证有效”。总体可用性须与各环节一致。给出为解决现有缺口而需要补读的具体来源或要确认的问题；尚未取得的材料只能作为查找建议。
6. **生成交付。** 运行 `python3 <skill>/scripts/render_report.py --claims claims.json --verification verification.json --index index --out report.md`。渲染器拒绝失败或与当前材料不匹配的旧核验。交付报告、claims.json、verification.json及索引；必要时附图表截图。报告须解释方法为何相关、关键结论依赖什么条件、用户下一步能据此作什么判断。不要把“脚本PASS”当语义正确率。

## UNKNOWN 的处理

为尚未确定的项写具体 `absence_probe` 检索词、`search_scope`（例如所供正文PDF，不含补充材料）及 `reasoning`。脚本实际执行检索，返回命中页和上下文。

关键词零命中不证明作者没有讨论；关键词命中也不保证回答了目标问题。阅读命中上下文并解释缺口，避免“搜不到某个词→整篇论文不存在这个事实”。部分材料中的缺口不得扩大成整个研究的缺口。

## 异常出口

- PDF无可读文本：索引返回 `insufficient_text` 和退出码2。若无已获授权且可核查的OCR路径，停止定量解读，交付材料状态、尚不能回答的问题和获取文本/OCR的建议。若已有OCR结果，可明确其来源与识别局限后另行审阅；本版脚本不自动OCR。
- 输入损坏、路径无效或抽取工具失败：保存错误，提供恢复方法，不生成成功审计报告。
- 缺页/缺补充材料：继续已提供范围的阅读，标明受影响结论，暂缓缺证据的判断。
- 预算结束：保留已完成输出与未核验清单；不得为了完成报告补写事实。

## 交付检查

- 关注项有对应证据或明确缺口，避免只核查“已经写出来的数”而漏掉任务主干。
- 图表与主张的比较对象、数据划分、指标和条件相符，保留反例及不利结果。
- 每项迁移建议可回到证据和用户实际条件；假设、外推和不确定性可辨识。
- 原件、原始输出、修正、工具成本和无法取得的信息如实留存。文本抽取与语义解释的限制分别说明。

Grid Search and Sets with Low Effective Dimensionality It is an interesting mathematical challenge to choose a set of trials for sampling functions of unknown, but low effective dimensionality. We would like it to be true that no matter which dimensions turn out to be important, our trials sample the important dimensions evenly. Sets of points with this property are well studied in the literature of Quasi-Random methods for numerical integration, where they are known as low-discrepancy sets because they try to match (minimize discrepancy with) the uniform distribution. Although there are several formal definitions of low discrepancy, they all capture the intuition that the points should be roughly equidistant from one another, in order that there be no “clumps” or “holes” in the point set. Several procedures for constructing low-discrepancy point sets in multiple dimensions also try to ensure as much as possible that subspace projections remain low-discrepancy sets in the subspace. For example, the Sobol (Antonov and Saleev, 1979), Halton (Halton, 1960), and Niederreiter (Bratley et al., 1992) sequences, as well as latin hypercube sampling (McKay et al., 1979) are all more or less deterministic schemes for getting point sets that are more representative of random uniform draws than actual random uniform draws. In Quasi Monte-Carlo integration, such point sets are shown to asymptotically minimize the variance of finite integrals faster than true random uniform samples, but in this section, we will look at these point sets in the setting of relatively small sample sizes, to see if they can be used for more efficient search than random draws. Future Work Our result on the multidimensional interval task, together with the GPR characterization of the shape of Ψ, together with the computational constraint that hyper-parameter searches only draw on a few hundred trials, all suggest that pseudo-random or quasi-random trials are optimal for non-adaptive hyper-parameter search. There is still work to be done for each model family, to establish how it should be parametrized for i.i.d. random search to be as reliable as possible, but the most promising and interesting direction for future work is certainly in adaptive algorithms. There is a large body of literature on global optimization, a great deal of which bears on the application of hyper-parameter optimization. General numeric methods such as simplex optimization (Nelder and Mead, 1965), constrained optimization by linear approximation (Powell, 1994; Weise, 2009), finite difference stochastic approximation and simultaneous prediction stochastic approximation (Kleinman et al., 1999) could be useful, as well as methods for search in discrete spaces such as simulated annealing (Kirkpatrick et al., 1983) and evolutionary algorithms (Rechenberg, 1973; Hansen et al., 2003). Drew and de Mello (2006) have already proposed an optimization algorithm that identifies effective dimensions, for more efficient search. They present an algorithm that distinguishes between important and unimportant dimensions: a low-discrepancy point set is used to choose points in the important dimensions, and unimportant dimensions are “padded” with thinner coverage and cheaper samples. Their algorithm’s success hinges on the rapid and successful identification of important dimensions. Sequential model-based optimization methods and particularly Bayesian optimization methods are perhaps more promising because they offer principled approaches to weighting the importance of each dimension (Hutter, 2009; Hutter et al., 2011; Srinivasan and Ramakrishnan, 2011). With so many sophisticated algorithms to draw on, it may seem strange that grid search is still widely used, and, with straight faces, we now suggest using random search instead. We believe the reason for this state of affairs is a technical one. Manual optimization followed by grid search is easy to implement: grid search requires very little code infrastructure beyond access to a cluster of computers. Random search is just as simple to carry out, uses the same tools, and fits in the same workflow. Adaptive search algorithms on the other hand require more code complexity. They require client-server architectures in which a master process keeps track of the trials that have completed, the trials that are in progress, the trials that were started but failed to complete. Some kind of shared database and inter-process communication mechanisms are required. Trials in an adaptive 301

Conclusion Grid search experiments are common in the literature of empirical machine learning, where they are used to optimize the hyper-parameters of learning algorithms. It is also common to perform multistage, multi-resolution grid experiments that are more or less automated, because a grid experiment with a fine-enough resolution for optimization would be prohibitively expensive. We have shown that random experiments are more efficient than grid experiments for hyper-parameter optimization in the case of several learning algorithms on several data sets. Our analysis of the hyper-parameter response surface (Ψ) suggests that random experiments are more efficient because not all hyperparameters are equally important to tune. Grid search experiments allocate too many trials to the exploration of dimensions that do not matter and suffer from poor coverage in dimensions that are important. Compared with the grid search experiments of Larochelle et al. (2007), random search found better models in most cases and required less computational time. Random experiments are also easier to carry out than grid experiments for practical reasons related to the statistical independence of every trial. • The experiment can be stopped any time and the trials form a complete experiment. • If extra computers become available, new trials can be added to an experiment without having to adjust the grid and commit to a much larger experiment. • Every trial can be carried out asynchronously. • If the computer carrying out a trial fails for any reason, its trial can be either abandoned or restarted without jeopardizing the experiment. Random search is not incompatible with a controlled experiment. To investigate the effect of one hyper-parameter of interest X, we recommend random search (instead of grid search) for optimizing over other hyper-parameters. Choose one set of random values for these remaining hyper-parameters and use that same set for each value of X. Random experiments with large numbers of trials also bring attention to the question of how to measure test error of an experiment when many trials have some claim to being best. When using a relatively small validation set, the uncertainty involved in selecting the best model by crossvalidation can be larger than the uncertainty in measuring the test set performance of any one model. It is important to take both of these sources of uncertainty into account when reporting the uncertainty around the best model found by a model search algorithm. This technique is useful to all experiments (including both random and grid) in which multiple models achieve approximately the best validation set performance. Low-discrepancy sequences developed for QMC integration are also good alternatives to gridbased experiments. In low dimensions (e.g., 1-5) our simulated results suggest that they can hold some advantage over pseudo-random experiments in terms of search efficiency. However, the trials 302

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "cat > out/reading_judgment.md <<'MD'
# 阅读判断：建议采用独立随机搜索作为首版基线

**结论：可以采用，但需要为表格模型重新设计搜索空间与验证协议；总体适配为“需改造”。** 六个参数的重要性未知，又随任务分布变化，随机搜索能避免规则网格把大量预算花在不重要维的重复取值组合上。这是本文机制与实验对首版选择的支持，不是本流程36次训练的胜出保证。本文研究图像分类神经网络和DBN，没有验证我们的表格数据或模型。[I1、U1]

这里的“独立随机”是先规定配置的联合分布，再独立抽取候选，训练后按验证目标择优；不根据已观察到的成绩改变后续采样。混合类别、整数和条件分支时，独立的是各次候选抽样，不能据此要求所有参数无条件相互独立。固定种子、保存分布定义及每次训练记录，才能追溯。其输出是已评估配置中的验证优胜者，不是全空间最优解。[C1、C2、C10、I2]

图1（PDF p.4）是机制示意：横轴重要、纵轴不重要，九点网格在重要轴只有三个位置，九个随机点有九个不同位置；无关轴的变化对响应几乎没帮助。预算不因此自动变成九个独立的“成功机会”：离散值可重复、随机点可聚集，多维交互也可能使好区域很窄。图7的GP敏感性分析及p.15把本文七参数问题的有效维数描述为一至四，并指出重要参数跨数据集变化。我们不知道自己的六维问题是否满足这个结构；若少数重要参数早已确定，或目标区形状与规则网格相配，网格仍可能合理。本文模拟中也有网格最好情况，不能宣布随机普遍最优。[C3–C5、C21、I1]

| 实验 | 搜索对象、空间与预算 | 能支持什么及限制 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 图5，PDF p.11–12 | 八个图像分类任务；单隐藏层神经网络；无预处理、七参数；随机总池256次，取其中71个无预处理试验；旧规则网格平均100次 | 图注明确说8次随机匹配或超过旧网格；是本文条件下的效率证据，不是每次8抽均成功。作者称搜索区域/密度大致相同，而非严格相同离散候选集合。[C6、C7、C11] |
| 图6，PDF p.11、13 | 加入标准化/PCA的九参数随机空间；对照仍是无预处理、平均100次旧网格 | 扩空间后正文称需32次而非8次稳定胜过旧网格，64次及以上可找到更优配置。图注所说扩展网格平均500次是所需组合数的说明，不是已经完成的500次对照实验。[C8、C9] |
| 图9，PDF p.18–21 | 随机在一/二/三层DBN空间抽样，最多32参数；128次随机对比专家辅助网格；旧DBN-3平均41次，各集13至102次 | 对旧三层结果三差、四平、一优；随机对旧一层结果至少一样好，但随机允许选层数。比较非等训练次数，人工还利用跨任务经验，评分加权口径不同。[C14–C17] |

这些预算首先是**候选模型训练次数**。不同配置的规模、停止时机和耗时不同，不能把“8对平均100次”直接当成统一墙钟加速比，也不能把DBN的128对平均41写成公平等预算胜负。神经网络效率曲线由独立随机试验分组，纵轴是按验证不确定性加权后的测试准确率；大预算时分组数少，用散点表示，不能当成大量新跑的重复搜索。验证集负责选择、测试集负责评估，两者不能混用。[C12、C13、C16、C17]

图9已核对八个面板及红/绿虚线：三层人工对照为红粗虚线，一层为绿细虚线。正文较差任务为 mnist background images、mnist background random、mnist rotated background images；convex 更好，其余四集相当。这里只采用图注与正文的描述，不估读曲线精确值或重新宣布统计显著。**尚未解决的原文矛盾：摘要p.1写七集，图9和p.21列八集。** 本报告保留矛盾，按有逐集列名、与面板吻合的正文汇总；无补充材料可供解释。[C14、C15、C19]

搜索空间和抽样概率直接决定有限预算的机会。论文实际含等概率类别、对数尺度数值、条件预处理等，并非所有参数在线性原值上均匀。所谓好配置区域的大小，应按所选抽样分布的概率质量理解；范围过宽或给坏选项过大概率，会让36次消耗在低价值区域。理论上，若每次独立抽样进入预先定义的好区域的概率为 p，36次至少一次命中为 "'`1-(1-p)''^36`；这是条件概率推导，不是本文测得的表格任务胜率。我们不知道 p，也不知道好区域是否覆盖所需的泛化表现，故不给数值保证。[C8、C10、C11、C18、I2、U1]

随机搜索与自适应搜索的关系应保留开放：随机搜索提供简单、易并行、可追加预算的比较基线；它不利用历史结果，遇到窄好区域可能持续错过。DBN专家顺序法说明借助反馈与经验可能有益，但不是本文对现代贝叶斯优化器等方法的严格同预算试验。论文推荐把随机作为未来自适应方法的基线，并没有证明自适应不值得做；当年对软件工程难度的讨论也不能外推为今天具体工具的限制。[C18、C20、I3]

首版适配建议（以下为推断与设计建议，尚未执行）：

1. 明确六参数的名称、类型、合法组合、合理范围、尺度及类别概率；为不同任务可预先设定有依据的空间，但比较算法时冻结相同空间。跨数量级正参数可考虑对数尺度，不能不加判断地照抄本文区间。[C10、C11、I2]
2. 预先确定独立抽样分布和36次完整训练的记账规则，保存配置、种子、失败状态、验证成绩及耗时。失败/重试是否消耗预算要说清，不能免费补成36个成功候选；若需要多折或多种子，每次拟合都要计入36次。不能只跑一次随机搜索就声称已测得稳定优势。[C2、C18、I2、U1]
